actual_collatz_finite_prefixes.scope: Finite-prefix minima only. No future minimum or convergence decision; no assertion for all cutoffs.

escaping_comparison_gauges.scope: All source classifications end at 1 or the previously kernel-proved infinite spine. Gauge series and infinite uniformity are written deductions, not inferred from the samples.

bounded_mean_comparison.map: J(2^k)=2^(k+1) for k>=1; J(n)=1 otherwise. Not Collatz; does not retain even halving.
bounded_mean_comparison.written_conclusion: Uniform first means are bounded by 3 and their supremum is 3, but minimum tails are not uniformly integrable. The limiting minimum law is delta_1.
